name: AHK Hotstring Clipper
description: Turn highlighted text into an AutoHotkey v2 hotstring. Local only: it talks to a native host on this PC and never to the network.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
